answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 24734 Country: India Title: My name is Mohammed Rafi, my question is i am 26yrs old and i am a student.Im going to get marry in two months but im not earning my father and mother are earning,so i dont have money to pay mahram,so is it ok that my parents pay mahram ? Or what is the correct way? please reply me as soon as possible. Question: Asalam kum Mufti saab my name is Mohammed Rafi, my question is i am 26yrs old and i am a student.Im going to get marry in two months but im not earning my father and mother are earning,so i dont have money to pay mahram,so is it ok that my parents pay mahram ? Or what is the correct way? please reply me as soon as possible. Jazak allah. Answer ID: 24734 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1323/L=396/tl=1431) Your parents too can pay your mahr. It is not necessary on you to pay it from your money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
